programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # The lattice color is strongest in both complete rows and complete columns.
    scores = {}
    for color in colors:
        row_peak = max(row.count(color) for row in grid)
        col_peak = max(sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) for c in range(w))
        scores[color] = row_peak / w + col_peak / h
    line_color = max(scores, key=scores.get)
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r].count(line_color) >= w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) >= h / 2]
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in rows and c not in cols]
    default = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            if corners[0] != line_color and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(default)
        out.append(row)
    active_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(out) if any(v != default for v in row)]
    active_cols = [j for j in range(len(out[0])) if any(out[i][j] != default for i in range(len(out)))]
    if not active_rows or not active_cols:
        return out
    return [row[min(active_cols):max(active_cols)+1] for row in out[min(active_rows):max(active_rows)+1]]
'''
path=programs/'task-3a4b72f9.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
